newsitem.title: DENMARK: POLL-Analysts see unchanged Danish June yr/yr CPI.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Analysts see unchanged Danish June yr/yr CPI.

text.p: Eleven analysts polled by Reuters forecast that Denmark's June consumer price index would be at 2.1 percent on a year-to-year basis, unchanged from May.
The estimates ranged from 2.0 percent to 2.4 percent.

"We expect that the shifting back of the summer sales to June from July because of the bad weather should have a positive effect on CPI, especially for clothing and shoes," senior Unidanmark analyst Klaus Dalsgaard told Reuters.
The panel also predicted an average year-on-year wholesale price index rise of 2.0 percent for June, compared to May's 1.9 percent, with estimates within the 1.7 to 2.3 percent range.
The Danish national statistics office issues its June CPI data on Wednesday July 23 with June WPI figures due on Friday July 25, both at 0730 GMT.
